# authwise_guard_pool_relay (Resource)

A relay of an estate relay pool. Operators only. Changing `pool` moves the relay; it learns the move on its next report.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A relay of an estate pool. Changing pool moves it in place.
resource "authwise_guard_pool_relay" "us_central_a" {
  pool         = authwise_guard_relay_pool.us_central.name
  display_name = "us-central-a"
  url          = "wss://a.us-central.relay.example.com/v1/transport"
  region       = "us-central1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `pool` (String)
- `url` (String)

### Optional

- `ca_cert_pem` (String)
- `config` (String) `config` as a JSON object.
- `display_name` (String)
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `priority` (Number)
- `region` (String)

### Read-Only

- `guard_pool_relay_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
- `has_credential` (Boolean)
- `last_report_at` (String) `last_report_at` as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `name` (String) Full resource name; serves as the Terraform ID.
- `reported_version` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by id or by full resource name.
terraform import authwise_guard_pool_relay.us_central_a rl-01
terraform import authwise_guard_pool_relay.us_central_a pool-relays/rl-01
```
